title: Lover's Weaponery
description: a pink-ish valentine's themed 1.8.9 texture pack
body:
Lover's Weaponery is a texture pack purely based arround the valentine's day aesthetic (even though it's released late lmao)


It is mainly made fpr 1.8.9 bedwars but can be used in whatever gamemode in this version you'd like.


It has a pink-ish theme arround the whole pack as well as a lot of hearts, as the theme suggests


Here are some screenshots with the pack :)


![Lover's Weaponery - #1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1d4bef1ae7588118f9c5b0311af6065f2f11791.jpeg)

![Lover's Weaponery - #2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d29887d01c7c82984358798313558611fc69d67.jpeg)

![Lover's Weaponery - #3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a0d169434767dce5045a191c5962908e3e43908.jpeg)


Sidenote : Feel free to join the discord if there is any issues with the Texture pack (Rendering Issues, Crashes, Textures not working properly, Sky glitches and/or not rendering...) It helps us greatly improve the work we do and provide the best for you all !
